name: Thunderguards MC
description: The Thunderguards MC is a Black one-percenter outlaw motorcycle club founded in 1965 in Wilmington, Delaware. The club is considered one of the most prominent Black OMGs on the East Coast, with chapters in Delaware, Georgia, and South Carolina, among others. The Thunderguards maintain ties to the Pagans MC and have been cited in the 2015 National Gang Threat Assessment for exclusively male membership.
